scope: Automotive intelligent driving, AI Cube, robot domain control, Chuanxing Zhiyuan low-speed autonomous vehicles, and adjacent L4 Robotaxi platform.
terminology_boundary: Physical AI is an analyst research label. Issuer sources use intelligent driving, embodied intelligence, robot, unmanned vehicle, and Robotaxi.

source_policy.primary_sources: Issuer statutory annual report, issuer IR activity records, and issuer corporate-news pages.
source_policy.secondary_source_policy: Broker research may identify questions but cannot establish customer, order, revenue, ASP, margin, or valuation facts without issuer or customer evidence.
source_policy.cutoff_rule: A plan, product release, POC, cooperation agreement, nomination, or unspecified order is not treated as revenue, backlog, completed SOP, gross profit, or EPS.

evidence_ladder.description: FY2025 automotive intelligent-driving revenue and scaled delivery to named OEMs.
evidence_ladder.valuation_treatment: Reported business economics only; not robot or low-speed-vehicle revenue.

evidence_ladder.description: AI Cube release, robot-controller nomination/planned 2026 delivery, and low-speed-vehicle release / unspecified customer orders.
evidence_ladder.valuation_treatment: Milestone option; zero base-case incremental EPS until financial conversion is disclosed.

evidence_ladder.description: NVIDIA Thor POC and DeepRoute L4 Robotaxi cooperation.
evidence_ladder.valuation_treatment: Technology and partner catalyst only; no base-case revenue or multiple credit.

claims.claim: FY2025 automotive intelligent-driving revenue was CNY9.70bn, up 32.63% year-on-year, with scaled delivery across named OEM customers.
claims.exact_status: Revenue realised and scaled automotive delivery confirmed.
claims.named_customer_availability: Available for automotive OEMs: Xiaomi, Li Auto, Great Wall, XPeng, Geely, GAC Toyota, Dongfeng Nissan, Chery, and GAC Honda. No robot or low-speed customer can be inferred.
claims.order_availability: Segment annualised new-project sales exceed CNY13bn; no customer-level order allocation.
claims.margin_availability: Segment margin is disclosed in the annual report, but no Physical-AI subsegment margin is disclosed.
claims.evidence_gap: Automotive intelligent-driving revenue is not a direct measure of robot, low-speed-vehicle, or Robotaxi revenue.
claims.valuation_consequence: Use as the monetised capability base only; do not add it again as Physical-AI revenue.

claims.claim: AI Cube was formally released as a robot AI computing terminal reusing automotive-grade redundant design, high-performance compute, middleware, and algorithm framework.

sources.title: Desay SV officially releases AI Cube

claims.exact_status: Product release confirmed; not a financial launch.
claims.order_availability: Not disclosed in the product-release source.
claims.evidence_gap: No contract, customer, configuration, delivery, production date, price, or cost evidence; award recognition is not commercial evidence.
claims.valuation_consequence: Technology/product option only; exclude from revenue bridge and valuation until commercial conversion is disclosed.

claims.claim: The company reports strategic cooperation with multiple robot companies, a robot-domain-controller project nomination order, and planned mass-production delivery in 2026.
claims.exact_status: Cooperation and a nomination order are issuer-confirmed; 2026 mass production is a plan, not a reported completion.
claims.order_availability: A nomination order is disclosed, but amount, programme, units, exclusivity, and conversion terms are not disclosed.
claims.production_or_sop_availability: Planned for 2026; no reported completion by the evidence cutoff.
claims.evidence_gap: No named customer, SOP date, first delivery, separate revenue, gross profit, or operating cash-flow evidence.
claims.valuation_consequence: 2026 milestone option with zero base-case incremental EPS. Add financial credit only after disclosed delivery, revenue and gross-profit evidence.

claims.claim: Chuanxing Zhiyuan launched S6 wing-door and side-door low-speed autonomous-vehicle products for last-mile logistics applications.

sources.title: Chuanxing Zhiyuan brand and S6 product release

claims.named_customer_availability: Not disclosed; only application categories are named.
claims.order_availability: Not disclosed in these two sources.
claims.production_or_sop_availability: Product release is disclosed; no separately disclosed SOP or delivery timetable.
claims.evidence_gap: Product specifications and addressable scenes are not proof of recurring commercial economics.
claims.valuation_consequence: Addressable-market and data-flywheel option only; not a separately modelled revenue line.

claims.claim: The company says Chuanxing Zhiyuan obtained relevant customer orders; later corporate news states that it completed scaled commercial rollout.
claims.exact_status: Unspecified customer orders are issuer-confirmed. The scaled-commercial-rollout phrase is an unquantified issuer corporate-news assertion, not an audited operating metric.
claims.order_availability: Orders are described but value, vehicle count, schedule, acceptance, and repeat-order rate are not disclosed.
claims.production_or_sop_availability: Not disclosed as a verified quantitative metric.
claims.evidence_gap: Scale and unit economics cannot be verified from either disclosure; no customer-side confirmation was located in the issuer source set.
claims.valuation_consequence: Conditional option only. Do not convert the order wording or corporate-news statement into backlog, revenue, or EPS.

claims.claim: The NVIDIA Thor / NVLink intelligent-driving solution is under development for mass production, has completed POC validation, and is stated to be extensible to embodied intelligence and edge computing.
claims.exact_status: POC completion and development status confirmed; serial-production delivery is not confirmed.
claims.named_customer_availability: NVIDIA is named as technology partner; end customer and vehicle programme are not disclosed.
claims.evidence_gap: POC and technical reference architecture do not establish a programme award or commercial contribution.
claims.valuation_consequence: Technical catalyst only; no direct revenue or multiple credit until an awarded programme, SOP and economics are disclosed.

claims.claim: Desay SV and DeepRoute.ai signed an agreement to jointly develop an overseas L4 Robotaxi solution, with Desay SV providing compute platform and sensor kit.
claims.exact_status: Named ecosystem cooperation confirmed; overseas delivery is planned.
claims.named_customer_availability: DeepRoute.ai is named; no end fleet operator, OEM, or programme customer is disclosed.
claims.order_availability: Cooperation agreement only; no purchase order or volume disclosed.
claims.production_or_sop_availability: No SOP or actual delivery disclosed.
claims.evidence_gap: Cooperation agreement is not a purchase order; the source describes commercialisation as a future objective.
claims.valuation_consequence: L4 platform option and technology-stack validation only; zero base-case revenue and multiple credit.

negative_findings: No issuer disclosure located through the cutoff that names a robot customer or programme.
No issuer disclosure located through the cutoff that states robot-controller or S6 unit volume, ASP, separate revenue, gross profit, operating cash flow, or working-capital burden.
No issuer disclosure located through the cutoff that confirms completion of the planned 2026 robot-controller mass-production delivery.
No issuer disclosure located through the cutoff that permits conversion of an unnamed order, POC, strategic cooperation, product release, or corporate-news statement into backlog or EPS.

valuation_rule.base_case: No incremental Physical-AI EPS credit; keep reported automotive intelligent-driving economics separate.
valuation_rule.scenario_eligibility: Use a probability-gated scenario only after evidence progresses through named customer/programme, SOP or accepted delivery, units/revenue, and gross-profit/cash-conversion disclosure.
valuation_rule.no_double_counting: FY2025 CNY9.70bn automotive intelligent-driving revenue validates the capability base but is not robot, low-speed-vehicle, or Robotaxi revenue.

next_verification_events: Named robot customer, controller programme, order amount or unit volume.
Confirmed 2026 robot-controller SOP / accepted first delivery.
Chuanxing Zhiyuan named customer, vehicle fleet size, order value, delivery and repeat order.
Separate revenue, gross margin, R&D burden, receivables / cash collection for new businesses.
NVIDIA Thor or DeepRoute awarded programme, SOP, units, revenue and commercial margin.
